article.story: OXFORD, Ohio -- — Peter Suder scored a career-high 42 points to lead Miami (OH) to a 73-60 victory over Air Force on Monday night. Suder, a junior whose previous high was 24 points, made 17 of 21 shots from the floor for the RedHawks (5-2). He hit 3 of 4 from 3-point range and 5 of 9 at the free-throw line, adding three steals. Eian Elmer had nine points and seven rebounds. The Falcons (2-7) were led by Luke Kearney with 16 points. Ethan Taylor totaled 12 points, five assists and two steals, while Caleb Walker scored 11. Suder scored 25 points in the second half to help lead Miami (OH) to a 13-point victory. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
